name: pokemon-mercari-sniper
description: Internal Mercari deal sniper (auto-heart): scan strategies, PokeGrade grade/raw comps, heart ≥1.25× deals; sibling module to sell-side auto-lister.
goals: Scan Mercari searches on an interval; price new listings via PokeGrade first-photo CDN
Auto-heart clear underpriced deals; track worklist and suspect outliers
Share Mercari Chrome session with sell-side via mutex; never buy or send offers
Expose read-only Scalper status on the LAN dashboard
nonGoals: eBay/Vinted watchers, ledger UI, fee P&L
Second Chrome profile or Task Scheduler job
technicalNotes: Node ESM sibling under src/sniper/. SNIPER_ENABLED gate. State in data/sniper/. Reuse pokegrade client + mercari browser. Tests with fakes only.

requirements.description: Deal math: heart ≥1.25×, worklist 1.15–1.25×, suspect ≥5×, skip below
acceptance: decideDeal(market, ask, thresholds) returns heart | worklist | suspect | skip

requirements.description: Durable seen vs hearted state under data/sniper/; crash-safe no double-heart
acceptance: hearted checked before click; seen marked only after durable success

requirements.description: PokeGrade graded comps + evaluateImageUrl + item-id cache
acceptance: Sell path still uses raw value + image hash cache; sniper can cache by item id

requirements.description: Mercari search scan + ItemLike heart (fakes in CI)
acceptance: Parse first money token; skip SOLD; never use discounted struck-through price alone

requirements.description: Shared Mercari page mutex for sell drafts and sniper
acceptance: withMercariPage serializes; no second profile launch

requirements.description: Sniper cycle + scheduler wired behind SNIPER_ENABLED
acceptance: Default off; when enabled runs strategies from config/sniper-strategies.json

requirements.description: Read-only Scalper status API + dashboard panel
acceptance: GET /api/sniper returns last cycle, heart counts, recent hearts/worklist
